title: The Rook Must Interpose
setup: Black has a rook on c8, a rook on e7 and a bishop on h8, and your queen sits on b7 in the middle of it.
hint: Ask which black piece is allowed to answer a check on the back rank, and what it has to give up to do it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxc8+}} removes one rook and the other has to block with {{Re8}} — the king has no square. {{Qxe8#}} takes it back. Counting the defenders is worth more here than counting the material.
